title: Strict-system normalization for the diagonal limit
statement: The diagonal cycle-system assertion determines a strict-system Ext class with its prescribed source counit, boundary hom formula and finite Cartier normalization, as expressed by DiagonalStrictDataSpec. This step asserts no inverse limit or completed-coefficient compatibility.

Apply the generic diagonalStrictData_map_finite to preserve those witnesses and their hom formulas, converting their finite equation with diagonalLimitFiniteNormalization_of_input. This separates system witness recovery from finite equality conversion without adding any proof obligation.

theorem diagonal_strict_limit_data (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec ℓ Y hY D) :
    DiagonalStrictLimitSpec ℓ Y hY D
